# awscc_apiportal_portal_publication (Data Source)

Data Source schema for AWS::APIPortal::PortalPublication



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `id` (String) Uniquely identifies the resource.

### Read-Only

- `change_token` (String) Customer-supplied change-trigger string. Any change forces a republish on UpdateHandler. Customers may set this to a literal token, a CFN parameter, or a Fn::Sub-composed string (for example, a concatenation of dependent resources' UpdatedAt attributes) to chain republish through CFN's dependency graph.
- `description` (String) A description of the changes made in this published version. Forwarded to PublishPortal.description.
- `portal_arn` (String) The ARN of the parent portal that this PortalPublication targets.
